description:
## 0.0.22-9 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22, synced with SysAdminDoc/HushGram up to 634cb4994. For Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* Glass share sheet: the reel stays visible behind a sheet and shows through it blurred, with glass Search and message boxes, glass rings on pictures and a purple glass Send.
* Upload developer names mapping is back under Open developer options, so MetaConfig shows flag names.
* Hide the exit button in clear mode now works on its own; leave clear mode from the reel's menu.
* The invisible Share button in clear mode works on reels the Liquid Glass bar lifts, with an Invisible Share touch area slider in Reels.
